task: Audacity is open with /home/user/Music/steady.wav loaded (a 5-second 440 Hz sine tone at constant amplitude 0.7). Apply a fade-in effect to the first 1 second (0 to 1s) and a fade-out effect to the last 1 second (4 to 5s). Export the result to /home/user/Music/faded.wav as a mono 44100 Hz 16-bit PCM WAV file.

verification.description: Start of track is faded in (near silent in first 50 ms)
End of track is faded out (near silent in last 50 ms)
Middle region retains full-amplitude tone (~-9 dB RMS for 0.5 amplitude sine)

cli_feasibility.translation: Using cli-anything-audacity: clip import/add → effect add fade-in/fade-out → metadata tag settings → export render operation
